## Hit dice

A fighter/wizard multiclass: one d10 and four d6, one of the d6 already
spent. d8 and d12 have no entry at all — this character has neither, and the
card offers **Add d8** and **Add d12** to add one. `Homebrew d4` is the
character's own: the layout never declared it, its name is a field rather than
static text, and no formula can name it.

```sheet
d6: 1 / 4
d10: 0 / 1
Homebrew d4: 1 / 2
```

## Kills

Nothing declared at all: every row here is one this character invented, and
the card is a label and an **Add** control until they do.

```sheet
Goblins: 6 / 10
Dragons: 3 / 5
```

## Clocks

The card's own segment count is 6, which is what the **Add** form's **Length**
field arrives holding — a seed for the field, never a second storage mode. The
name has a space in it, so it is a name no formula could have spelled even if
this component published one.

```sheet
Rescue the miners: 2 / 8
```
